$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFDM (AIP France, chart dated 2024-08-08): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Marmande - Virazeil

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

preferredQfuReason: preferred QFU 107, due to noise pollution
notes: Unpaved RWY reserved for gliders and home-based ACFT.
ULM base located in the 222°, 2.5 NM of ARP.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
ACFT code B: use TWY B and park on West apron Preferred QFU: 107°, due to noise pollution.
Approved with limitations because the power supply is not backed up.
1 - Home-based ACFT pilots: Have passed a practical assessment of night flying aptitude on site with a qualified instructor.

2 - Non-based ACFT pilots: Have a minimum of a 200 HR experience including 20 HR of night VFR; a recent practice (3 LDG and 3 TKOF within the last 3 months) is required, or have passed a practical assessment of aptitude for night flying on site with a qualified instructor.

Pilots must keep themselves advised with the special conditions of use of the aerodrome by means decided by the aerodrome operator and brought to user attention in aeronautical information publications TWY C and turning areas can't be used.
Aerobatics activity (NR 6696) on AD: RWY 11/29 axis.
Activiy known by AQUITAINE INFO / APP and MARMANDE A/A.
AEM (NR 9131) on AD: 330 ft ASFC - SR-SS.
Radio controlled model flying according to protocol.
